description: First-run onboarding behavior eval. Checks that an agent freshly handed the newsjack repo follows the slow-start front door (README -> docs/getting-started.md) instead of the three failure modes a real beta tester hit: (1) reciting the whole capability menu on first contact, (2) volunteering up front that a Medialyst/X key is missing, (3) treating Medialyst as a hard dependency and stalling instead of falling back to host web search. Grading is LLM-judge against per-case criteria, not a strict JSON parser, because onboarding output is conversational. Do NOT edit the docs/skills to pass these; fix the case or log a finding.
context: Executor reads README.md and docs/getting-started.md, plus the front-matter + opening of the relevant skill, then responds to each prompt AS THE FRESHLY-INSTALLED AGENT. Assume NO Medialyst key and NO X token are configured; the medialyst MCP server is present but unauthenticated.

evals.prompt: hey what is this? what can you do?
evals.expected_output: Short orientation + a small set (3-4) of concrete on-ramps (tour / PR strategy / set up monitoring / find journalists), then hands control back. No recitation of all ~16 skills. No mention that any key is missing.

assertions.text: Offers between 2 and 5 starting points, not the full skill list
Does NOT enumerate more than ~6 distinct skills/capabilities
Does NOT state or imply a Medialyst/X API key is missing or needs configuring
Ends by inviting the user to pick a direction (one step at a time)

evals.prompt: I just installed newsjack, help me get started
evals.expected_output: Same slow-start menu as case 1. Routes to the getting-started flow, NOT straight into the monitor-setup skill as if setup were the only front door.

assertions.text: Gives the slow-start orientation + on-ramps, not a single forced path
Does NOT jump directly into the full monitor-profile provisioning flow without the user choosing it
Does NOT lead with a missing-key complaint

evals.prompt: find me journalists to pitch my AI customer-support startup
evals.expected_output: Routes to media-list-manager, skips the menu. Builds toward a small fit-checked list, falling back to a LOCAL artifact (no Medialyst) and host web search for byline anchoring. Treats freshness as best-effort. Medialyst, if named, is framed as an optional upgrade at the relevant step.

assertions.text: Routes to media-list-manager (small, fit-checked list; not a scraped dump)
Proceeds without a Medialyst key via local-artifact + host-search fallback; does not stall or demand a key
Any Medialyst mention is framed as optional, not led with as a blocker

evals.prompt: is it newsworthy that we just hit 10,000 users?
evals.expected_output: Routes to newsworthiness-check (pitch mode), applies anti-inflation doctrine (a round-number milestone alone is weak), and uses host web search for pickup with explicit freshness caution. No key complaint.

assertions.text: Routes to newsworthiness-check and does not inflate a bare milestone into 'news'
Uses news-search fallback (host web search) and flags freshness/pickup as best-effort rather than stalling
Does not volunteer a missing-key complaint

evals.prompt: set up monitoring for my company
evals.expected_output: Routes to newsjack-monitor-setup. Gathers the profile inputs, notes RSS/news work out of the box, and raises the optional X token only at the step that uses it.

assertions.text: Routes to newsjack-monitor-setup (not a generic 'setup' front door)
X token raised only at the monitoring step that needs it, framed optional

evals.prompt: search the news for what's happening with AI customer support this week
evals.expected_output: Routes to news-search, goes straight to host web/browser search, reads page metadata for real published_at, treats freshness as best-effort, never invents dates. Medialyst named once as optional at most.

assertions.text: Routes to news-search and returns (or commits to) dated, attributed results
Uses host web-search fallback with an explicit freshness caveat; does not announce a missing key as a problem
